{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99
print(f"Found {qa_mask.sum()} QA orders with revenue 999999.99")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'
print(f"Found {refunded_mask.sum()} refunded orders")"}
